target_customer: Online sellers and brands selling across Asian marketplaces; later brands needing e-commerce operations and platform development
problem: Sellers on multiple Asian marketplaces face manual listing and order work for each platform. Branch8 offered one dashboard to list, update and manage products across marketplaces.
business_model: Subscription (from $315 to $715 per month after a free three months in 2015); later services and operations teams for e-commerce brands
product_category: Multi marketplace e-commerce management, later e-commerce services agency

founders.name: Matt Li
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him. TechCrunch August 2015 says the idea came from his own cross border selling.

founders.name: Elton Chan
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch August 2015 says he led electronics at Lazada. It names a CTO formerly of Facebook and Microsoft and a COO and CPO who were retailers, without names. The YC page does not list Chan, so founder status is unconfirmed and the CEO naming conflicts with the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrating many marketplace APIs with inconsistent formats, plus inventory and order sync, is standard but tedious engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Marketplace connectors can be copied, with some lock in from stored listings and order history.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The company later moved away from the marketplace tool to e-commerce operations and platform development on Shopify, Magento and Salesforce; no incumbent acquisition found.

market_need_then: TechCrunch August 2015: nearly 1,000 sellers, over 600,000 products and over $1 million in monthly sales processed, with the founder citing his own selling bottleneck across several marketplaces.

identity.voice_and_tone: Practical operations and e-commerce services language

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself was found, and the name resembles many other Branch companies in search results.

pivots.from: Multi marketplace listing and order management tool for sellers
pivots.to: E-commerce operations and platform development services for brands
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred from the 2015 TechCrunch article versus the current company site, date unknown

outcome_analysis: Branch8 launched in 2015 as a marketplace sync tool with early seller traction and later reshaped itself into an e-commerce operations and development services firm, claiming 150 plus client engagements, 8 plus years and named brand clients on its site. No venture funding beyond an unverified small seed was found, so it looks like a lean services business after a product pivot. Evidence for the pivot and its date is thin.
notes: Seedtable, an aggregator, lists $120K seed in August 2015 and CB Insights lists $120K over 4 rounds with a 2018 MaGIC accelerator entry; single aggregator figures are unverified and not recorded as rounds. The TechCrunch and YC page conflict on who leads the company (Elton Chan CEO vs Matt Li founder). The company site claims 8 plus years in operation, which is below the 2015 launch, and is self reported. No dated competitor beyond marketplaces being integrated was found, so the list is empty. LinkedIn snippet mentions moves from Hong Kong to London and then a Singapore APAC hub, undated. Completeness pass: Rounds rest on two databases (Seedtable for the 2015-08 seed of 120K USD, CB Insights for the 2018-06 accelerator entry with no amount); no press release found, and CB Insights total of 120K over 4 rounds is not reconciled.
